```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # Install root dependencies (if any)
      - name: Install root dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      # Memory‑mcp lint and tests
      - name: Install memory‑mcp dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen
        working-directory: memory-mcp

      - name: Run Ruff on memory‑mcp
        run: uv run ruff check .
        working-directory: memory-mcp

      - name: Run tests on memory‑mcp
        run: uv run pytest -v
        working-directory: memory-mcp

      # wifi‑cam‑mcp lint
      - name: Install wifi‑cam‑mcp dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen
        working-directory: wifi-cam-mcp

      - name: Run Ruff on wifi‑cam‑mcp
        run: uv run ruff check .
        working-directory: wifi-cam-mcp

      # README link check
      - name: Check README links
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v1
        with:
          args: README.md
```
